summary: One line of text that takes part in a form, with a visible label and optional hint.

usage.text: Use for one line of free text. For a choice from a known list, use example-select.

a11y.text: Set label; a placeholder is not a name.
Text in the hint slot is read as the field's description, after its name.

detail:
A single-line text field that takes part in forms.

Its value is submitted under its name attribute. Setting invalid marks the field for assistive technology; the reason belongs in the hint slot, where it is read as the description.
